# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Servicing fixes and TFM backports**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.5 delivers targeted bug fixes and Apple TFM improvements backported from the v4 line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL not found fixed for .NET 9** — Resolves a `DllNotFoundException` for the WinUI projection DLL when consuming SkiaSharp from .NET 9 WinUI applications. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))

## Platform

- **Apple platform TFMs corrected** — Library TFMs now use the versioned `26.0` moniker; app TFMs use the unversioned form, backporting the fix from the v4 line. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
